On 22 March 2010 at 08:34, Pranshu wrote:
| Eagerly waiting for more details :)

Allow me to make a suggestion: Stop spamming the list with content-free
posts. Especially after you just got two (!!) emails telling you to work on
your application.

Readers of this list comprise the very people who are ending up voting your
proposal (once we are at the "Google accepting student applications stage")
up or down which will determine final rankings. Think a little about how
such posts make you look and decide for yourself.

Now is the time to work with the topic mentor (or to come up with proposal on
your own, of course, but it would still need a mentor) on understanding the
topic __and coming up with well-reasoned arguments as to why your proposal
has merit, why you have the skills to pull it off and possibly also how you
plan to spend your time actually doing it__. In other words: prepare your
application. That means off-line.

You (as a student) are the one who ends up getting the check. So you are the
one who should be doing the work. This isn't 1st grade where teachers dictate
solutions. Show some maturity and indepedent thinking and convince us that
you are a student with merit.

Sorry for the bucket of cold water, but better now that never.

Dirk
